description.short_caption: Crusted and swollen lesion on the forehead and left periorbital region.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a crusted, scaly lesion with erythema and swelling involving the forehead and extending to the left periorbital region. The lesion appears to have areas of desquamation and possible exudation. The surrounding tissue is edematous, particularly around the left eye, which is partially swollen shut. The findings suggest an inflammatory or infectious process.
